originality.rationale: Došlá's (2009) general mixture test provides only an implicit criterion and its explicit logistic result concerns sech-squared rather than Debye's sech kernel. The new all-contrast parametric boundary, linear extreme-contrast coefficient and 2/3-power cusp are not stated or directly calculated there. The 2008 two-process spectroscopy paper uses a non-Debye secondary response; the previous equal-strength models do not cover asymmetric strengths. Remaining risk is an unindexed explicit derivation.
